name: codecollab
description: Incrementally ships each Claude Code turn's prompt + text reply to the tenant's gbrain, together with the paths of files edited and the repository, branch, author and commit the turn happened in. Never sends thinking, tool calls, code, or patches unless you opt in (VONIC_CAPTURE_THINKING / VONIC_CAPTURE_CODE, both off by default). After installing, run /codecollab:login, then /codecollab:backfill for existing sessions.
